PDF Octree Light Propagation Volumes
Light Propagation Volumes [Kap09] (LPV) is a technique which approximates global illumination, specifically diffuse indirect lighting, without any preprocessing stage, in realtime. While LPV runs in real-time, the uniform grid representation does limit the scalability.
